onboarding.title: Turn on required permissions
onboarding.lead: Jiti needs to read text you select in other apps so it can translate in one step. This is a one-time grant; you can review it later in Settings.
onboarding.step1: Click Turn on, then find Jiti in the system list
onboarding.step3: Return here; the status updates automatically

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Read selected text in other apps, with a simulated copy fallback when direct access fails.
accessibility.hintOff: Find Jiti in System Settings and turn the switch on. Come back here; the status updates automatically.
accessibility.hintOn: If selected text still cannot be read after granting access, quit from the tray and open the app again.
